caption: The drawing consists of three main objects depicted in black lines on a beige background. The first object on the left is a side view of a humanoid doll with an oval head, simple facial features, an elongated neck, and jointed limbs, showing some minor spots and marks. The second object in the center shows a front view of the same doll, displaying both arms, hands with distinguishable fingers, and the basic structure of its torso and legs, with visible seam lines and minimal detail on the body. The third object on the right is a long dress designed to fit the doll, featuring short sleeves, a round neckline with trim, a sash or belt tied at the waist, and a long, slightly flared skirt with a stitched hem. There is a small scale of inches below the center object that measures up to three inches, and the objects are labeled with the numbers 1, 2, and 3 under each figure.
title: Doll
